doc: Decode of the two raw files of a bodies-file record (written to a temporary directory by the case builder, 12x5; the files hold exactly the input arrays, little-endian): land = u8 / 255 as float32, elevation = max(int16 / 1000, 0) as float32 (a float32 division by 1000, correctly rounded; -32768..32767 and 0, +-1 included, negative metres become +0). Extra record keys (dem, seaFrom) are ignored. The output `source_utf8` holds the resulting Surface.source as UTF-8 bytes (a string cannot be an output array; params.expected_source repeats it): the record field `source`, "bodies/golden". The arrays are (height, width), row 0 north. The record names the files land.u8 and elev.i16, which exist only as the input arrays land_u8 and elevation_i16: a port decodes these arrays (or writes them to files of those names in a temporary directory and calls its own load). Tolerance: a single correctly-rounded float32 division of an integer: exact.
